job.question: In the Contra Costa County Employees' Retirement Association (CCCERA) April 2018 master custodian RFP, how many copies of the proposal must be submitted, and for how long must the proposal remain a firm and irrevocable offer?
job.expected_facts: One (1) original proposal, four (4) hard copies and one (1) copy in electronic form; the proposal must be a firm and irrevocable offer good for one year from the proposal due date (due 5:00 p.m. PT, Friday, May 25, 2018).
job.acceptance: Accept five paper sets total if the original is clearly included, plus one electronic copy; validity one year from due date. Actual proposal deadline is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a 2024 City of Baltimore BCERS alternatives-consultant RFP, not CCCERA’s April 2018 master-custodian RFP. Its submission requirement is one paper copy and one electronic copy, and its offer period is 180 days, so it cannot support the requested facts.
quotes: THE EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM and OPEB TRUST – CITY OF BALTIMORE REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP) for ALTERNATIVES CONSULTANT
Proposals must be received no later than 3:00 P.M. EDT, November 8, 2024.
One (1) electronic copy in PDF format must be emailed to: rfpers@bcers.org
Additionally, each proposing firm must submit one (1) paper version, all fully signed and sealed, to:
A statement to the effect that the proposal is a firm and irrevocable offer, good for 180 days from the deadline for submission of proposals.
